title: Holography and Kinematic Space for Gravitational Sub-regions in AdS
abstract: Extends Qiang Wen's partial-entanglement-entropy (PEE) thread program to kinematic space for gravitational subregions in AdS, with holographic tensor network models realizing surface-state correspondence and generalized entanglement wedges.
key_claims: PEE-thread/kinematic-space construction extended to gravitational subregions of AdS.
Holographic tensor network models realize surface-state correspondence and generalized entanglement wedges.
The networks reproduce RT/entropy (kinematic) data -- the same sector the project has already shown to be force-blind.
relevance_note: WATCH. Structurally adjacent to the REFUTED HYP-022 PEE-thread/Kirillov-Crofton route (SIM-024 gave alpha=0.883, not 4): reproducing RT/entropy data is exactly the integral-geometry sector this project proved does NOT produce the alpha=4 stress-tensor force. Catalogue-only tracking entry: watch whether the PEE-tessellation program ever claims DYNAMICAL (force/stress-tensor) content; as-is it makes no such claim and has no anchor contact. Same lineage as HYP-026 (Synge distance geometric but force-blind).
anchor_contradiction: None. Entropy/kinematic-space content only; does not claim force or stress-tensor dynamics, so it does not challenge the HYP-022 refutation or the alpha=4 anchors.
